title: tbnnFoam: OpenFOAM C++ In-Solver Tensor Basis Neural Network RANS Closure
description:
tbnnFoam is an in-situ coupled Reynolds-Averaged Navier–Stokes (RANS) solver within OpenFOAM 2606 featuring a dual-runtime inference architecture: an embedded LibTorch engine and a zero-dependency standalone C++ matrix evaluator with an analytical Cardano cubic eigensolver enforcing physical realizability on the Lumley triangle in \(\mathcal{O}(1)\) operations per cell.

Key highlights and capabilities:

  • Dual-Runtime Inference: Embedded LibTorch C++ evaluator and zero-dependency native C++ evaluator.
  • Analytical Realizability: Cardano cubic eigensolver guaranteeing positive-semidefinite Reynolds stresses on the Lumley triangle.
  • Cross-Engine Numerical Parity: PyTorch, TorchScript, and standalone C++ agree within an absolute tolerance of 10-5.
  • Boussinesq Limit Assembled Parity: Coupled momentum equation reduces exactly to baseline linear k–ω SST (maximum relative deviation 3.6 × 10-17).
  • Turbulent Duct Flow Benchmark: Verified against the DNS benchmark of Pirozzoli et al. (J. Fluid Mech. 2018) for developing square-duct flow at Reb = 4410 and Reb = 17,800.
  • Reproducibility: Includes pre-trained neural network weights, automated 21-test verification suite, and verification case configurations.
